name: Decisions lab test
description: Lab test of kiln.decisions and kiln.window_clock through Kiln.Api (07-cancelable-events): the services are on, an entity's identity is resolved in Pre and refused inside the simulation (asked from a world program's update, where the clock says phase 3), a decision filed in Pre is delivered, answered and completed once (allowed, refused, released after its deadline), spawned characters' deaths are held, refused, healed, filtered and allowed (events.death), and walk-over pickups of spawned drops on the research's range-only fixture are held, refused, re-asked and allowed (events.pickup), plain and with kiln/control/systems.parallel. PASS and FAIL lines in kiln.log, then 'decisions-api-test done: N PASS, 0 FAIL'.
